title: Times Tables, Mandelbrot and the Heart of Mathematics
summary: Mathologer shows how times table diagrams on a circle produce cardioids and other curves connected to the Mandelbrot set. He explains the patterns and links to a tool for making your own diagrams.
why: HN recommends it as the clearest explanation of the patterns behind modular multiplication diagrams and times table art.

quote.text: This YouTube video explains the algo behind what you're seeing.
